punchline: Micah True ran every day, went out on a routine twelve-mile run, and was found four days later beside a stream.
thirty_sec: In March 2012, fifty-eight-year-old Micah True left the lodge where he was staying in New Mexico's Gila Wilderness on a Tuesday for a twelve-mile run and did not return. Friends found him on Saturday evening beside a cold stream about a mile southeast of the Gila Cliff Dwellings. The cause of death was not disclosed in the report. A police lieutenant said going alone in that wilderness is risky.
